allow: Read and develop AgentViz in this repository and its AgentBoard managed worktrees.
Read the sibling AgentBoard source and documentation as references without changing that project.
Read only local provider metadata and transcripts needed for the named outcomes; retain no real payloads in fixtures or reports.
Use native Windows, synthetic tests, isolated browser/editor profiles, local commits and integration in the run's worktree.
Run the named check catalogue and create a local VSIX; use current signed in runtimes advertised by AgentBoard.
deny: Modify another project, provider configuration, secrets, hooks, transcripts or the user's normal editor profile.
Send external messages, publish, push, deploy, install a normal profile extension or start WSL.
Expose prompts, reasoning, source code, command arguments, raw transcript paths, credentials or tool output through the view or evidence.
Add network services, ports, databases, telemetry, model summaries or runtime dependencies without a demonstrated task need.
Edit AgentBoard task stores directly, discard worktrees, act on unrelated cards or evade approved run limits.
